notes.title: Platforms, Controllers, and Languages, Oh My!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you so much for your support of A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad.[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654992/db05fa05e68bab9ec015a2f1dda90729d45d5609.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]We have officially reached [b]1,000[/b] wishlists![/h2][p][/p][h3]To celebrate, I have some big announcements.

[i]Platform Support[/i] [/h3][p]APGTMYM will support [b]Windows[/b], [b]macOS[/b], and [b]Linux[/b] at launch! This means if you use a [b]Steam Deck[/b], native Linux and proton-supported builds will be available. [/p][p][/p][h3][i]Controller Support[/i] [/h3][p]Full controller support has been added to APGTMYM! You can use you [b]Xbox[/b] controller, [b]PlayStation[/b] controller, [b]Switch[/b] controller, or maybe even that weird controller you found at that garage sale! The controls feel great on the Steam Deck too![/p][p][/p][h3][i]Localization[/i][/h3][p]I have planned to support 17 languages at the launch of APGTMYM! This includes:[/p][list][*][p]English[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Thai[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Spain)[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish (Latin America)[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese (Brazil)[/p][/*][*][p]Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Czech[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654992/23bfd32b7ffdb4ee6229388393026921ca38e61d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad is coming sooner than you think! [/h3][p][/p][h3]Stay tuned for updates and get ready to get mad![/h3]

notes.title: A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad Announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Thank You ːsteamthumbsupː[/h3][p]First off, [b]Thank You[/b] to everyone who has supported development thus far! All the positive reception to the project has been amazing and I am excited to keep making the game better for you all![/p][p][/p][h3]Release Schedule[/h3][p]"A Pinball Game That Makes You Mad" is planned for release in [b]Late 2025[/b]. I want to ensure the game is on track to be a quality, bug-free experience before I announce a release date. [/p][h3]
Development Update[/h3][p]I will be providing development updates from here on out. I am a solo developer and I am always looking for feedback on the game mechanics and visuals of the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654992/052b168aad7e67b56301032a9afce1115bc95ce0.png"][/img][/p][p]Here are some features that are in development right now:[/p][list][*][p][b]Checkpoints and Skipping[/b][/p][p]Less-hardcore players will be able to optionally enable checkpoints, so the game doesn't make you quite so mad. Checkpoint skipping can also be enabled, allowing you to skip a section if you can't quite get past an obstacle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Themes[/b][/p][p]Themes allow you to changes the appearance and sounds of the game to spice up the experience. Some themes are "Classic", "Duck", and "Cat". [/p][/*][*][p][b]New Obstacles[/b][/p][p]New obstacles are constantly being added to add new ways to challenge your flipper skills. How's your balance?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Physics Improvements[/b][/p][p]The physics engine is being reworked to ensure that the game feels consistent and controllable. The game should make you mad, but not because of physics bugs.[/p][/*][/list]
